semantics.intervals: Each interval is [previous sample UTC, current sample UTC]; rates are derived from adjacent raw counters. Shared boundaries have zero measure.
semantics.weighting: Rates use overlap seconds as weights. CPU rates use counter-tick ratios; PSI and cgroup rates use monotonic elapsed seconds. PSI avg10/avg60/avg300 and recorded deltas are not used.
semantics.boundaries: Attribution within a partially overlapping interval assumes its measured rate and counter increments were uniform. Cgroup estimated totals prorate increments by wall-time overlap and may be fractional. Maxima are whole-interval rates for any interval with positive overlap, not instantaneous peaks.
semantics.scope: run.json start/end windows include checkpoint build, setup, warmup, measurement, and other launcher activity; they are not restricted to WorkloadActual iterations. Aggregate statistics cover the union of accepted windows, without double-counting overlap.
semantics.coverage: Time coverage and coverage of all eight required metrics are separate. Missing or decreasing counters are unavailable, never zero. Gaps between monitor sessions are uncovered; long within-session sampling intervals remain attributed and are counted explicitly.
semantics.isolation: The monitor's declared affinity is reported as metadata. CPU affinity and these observations do not establish exclusive CPU ownership, an offline SMT sibling, or host isolation. The KVM host is unreserved.

packaged_snapshot.note: Summary and deterministic gzip retain the same complete-record snapshot bytes.
